steps.title: Answer
steps.hint: Answer the question in one short sentence.

steps.title: Give an example
steps.hint: Add a detail or a short story from your life.

steps.title: Finish
steps.hint: Close with your opinion or a short conclusion.

example.question: What's your favourite hobby?
example.answer: My favourite hobby is travelling. I really enjoy it because I like seeing new places and meeting new people. For example, last summer I went to Portugal with two friends and we visited Lisbon and Porto. That's why I always save some money for my next trip.

questions.q: Can you introduce yourself?
questions.model: Of course. My name is Laura and I'm twenty-eight years old. I'm from Granada, but I live in Valencia now because of my job. I work in a bank, and in my free time I love dancing. I'm learning English because I'd like to work abroad one day.

questions.q: Where are you from?
questions.model: I'm from a small town near Seville, in the south of Spain. It's a quiet place with friendly people and very hot summers. For example, in August it's often over forty degrees. I love it, but I think it's a bit too quiet for young people.

questions.q: Where do you live?
questions.model: I live in a flat in the centre of Bilbao. I like it because everything is near: shops, cafés and my office. For example, I can walk to work in ten minutes. The only problem is that it's quite noisy at night.

questions.q: What do you do?
questions.model: I'm a nurse at a big hospital. I really like my job because I can help people every day. For example, last week I looked after an old man who was very ill, and now he's much better. It's hard work, but it's very rewarding.

questions.q: Why are you learning English?
questions.model: I'm learning English because I need it for my job. I work in a hotel and many of our guests are from other countries. For example, yesterday I helped a family from Canada. I think English opens a lot of doors, so I practise every day.

questions.q: What time do you usually get up?
questions.model: I usually get up at half past six on weekdays. I have to get up early because I start work at eight. For example, today I woke up even earlier because my alarm clock rang at six. At the weekend, though, I sleep until nine or ten.

questions.q: What do you do on a typical weekday?
questions.model: On a typical weekday I go to work in the morning and come home at about five. Then I go to the gym or I go for a walk, because I sit all day at work. In the evening I cook dinner and watch a series. It's a simple routine, but I like it.

questions.q: How do you usually travel to work or school?
questions.model: I usually go to work by bus. It's cheaper than driving and I can read on the way. For example, I finished a whole book last month on the bus. When the weather is nice, I sometimes cycle instead.

questions.q: What do you usually have for breakfast?
questions.model: I usually have toast with tomato and olive oil, and a coffee. It's a typical Spanish breakfast and it's quick to make. On Sundays I have a bigger breakfast with my family, with eggs and fresh orange juice. I think breakfast is the most important meal of the day.

questions.q: What do you do in the evenings?
questions.model: In the evenings I usually relax at home. I cook dinner, and then I watch a film or read. For example, last night I watched a comedy with my flatmate. I don't go out much during the week because I'm usually tired.

questions.q: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
questions.model: Yes, I have one older brother. He's thirty-five and he lives in Madrid with his wife and their two children. We don't see each other very often, but we talk on the phone every week. I think we get on better now than when we were children.

questions.q: What is your family like?
questions.model: My family is quite big and very noisy! I have two sisters, lots of cousins and four grandparents. For example, at Christmas there are more than twenty people at the table. It's a bit crazy, but I love it.

questions.q: Who are you most similar to in your family?
questions.model: I'm most similar to my father. We are both tall and we both have curly hair. We are also quite patient and calm. My mother always says that we laugh at the same jokes.

questions.q: What do you like doing with your family?
questions.model: I like cooking with my family. My grandmother teaches us her recipes, and then we all eat together. For example, last Sunday we made paella for twelve people. These moments are very special to me.

questions.q: Can you describe your best friend?
questions.model: My best friend is called Marta. She's quite short and she has long, straight black hair. She's very funny and generous, and she always helps me when I have a problem. We met at school twenty years ago, and we are still very close.

questions.q: Can you describe your home?
questions.model: I live in a small flat on the third floor. It has two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom. My favourite part is the balcony, because I can have breakfast there in the sun. It's not very big, but it's comfortable.

questions.q: What's your favourite room in your home?
questions.model: My favourite room is the living room. It has a big sofa, a lot of plants and a big window. I spend most of my free time there, reading or watching films. It's the place where I feel most relaxed.

questions.q: Would you prefer to live in a house or a flat?
questions.model: I'd prefer to live in a house with a garden. In a flat you can often hear your neighbours, and you can't have a big dog. For example, my friend has a house in the country and his children play outside all day. I think it's a healthier life.

questions.q: What would you change about your home?
questions.model: I'd like a bigger kitchen. At the moment there isn't space for a table, so we eat in the living room. I love cooking, so a bigger kitchen would make me very happy. Maybe one day I'll move to a bigger flat.

questions.q: Can you describe your town?
questions.model: My town is quite small, but it has everything you need. There's a market, a library, a sports centre and a lovely old square with cafés. In summer there's a festival with music in the streets. I'd like more things for young people, like a cinema.

questions.q: What do you do in your free time?
questions.model: In my free time I like going hiking and taking photos. I love being in nature because it helps me forget about work. For example, last month I walked to the top of a mountain near my town. I usually go with a group of friends at the weekend.

questions.q: How often do you do exercise?
questions.model: I do exercise three times a week. I go swimming on Mondays and Wednesdays, and I play football on Saturdays. I think exercise is important for your body and for your mind. When I don't do any, I feel tired and in a bad mood.

questions.q: What kind of music do you like?
questions.model: I like pop music and some rock. I listen to music every day, on the bus and when I'm cooking. Last year I went to a concert by my favourite band and it was amazing. I think music makes everything better.

questions.q: Do you prefer watching films at home or at the cinema?
questions.model: I prefer watching films at home. It's cheaper, and I can stop the film when I want. However, for big action films the cinema is better, because the screen and the sound are fantastic. So it depends on the film.

questions.q: Is there a new hobby that you would like to try?
questions.model: Yes, I'd love to learn to play the guitar. I've always liked music, but I've never played an instrument. My cousin plays very well and he says he can teach me. I think I'll start this summer, when I have more time.

questions.q: What's your favourite food?
questions.model: My favourite food is Italian food, especially pasta. I love it because it's simple, cheap and delicious. For example, I make spaghetti with tomato sauce at least once a week. I'd love to visit Italy one day and try the real thing.

questions.q: Do you prefer eating at home or in restaurants?
questions.model: I prefer eating at home during the week, because it's cheaper and healthier. But at the weekend I like going to restaurants with my friends. For example, last Saturday we tried a new Japanese restaurant. It's nice to try food that I can't cook myself.

questions.q: Can you cook?
questions.model: Yes, I can cook quite well. My mother taught me when I was a teenager. My best dish is a Spanish omelette with potatoes and onion. My friends always ask me to make it when they come for dinner.

questions.q: What's a typical dish from your country?
questions.model: A typical dish from Spain is paella. It's made with rice and usually has chicken, seafood or vegetables. People often eat it on Sundays with the whole family. Every region has its own way of making it, and everyone thinks theirs is the best!

questions.q: What did you eat yesterday?
questions.model: Yesterday I had a light breakfast, just a coffee and some fruit. For lunch I had lentil soup and grilled fish at work. In the evening I was tired, so I made a quick salad. I think it was quite a healthy day.

questions.q: Do you like travelling?
questions.model: Yes, I love travelling. I enjoy visiting new places, trying different food and meeting people. For example, two years ago I went to Morocco and it was a fantastic experience. I try to travel at least once a year.

questions.q: What's the best place you've ever visited?
questions.model: The best place I've ever visited is Iceland. The landscape is incredible, with mountains, waterfalls and black beaches. We also saw the northern lights, which was amazing. It's very expensive, but it was worth it.

questions.q: Have you ever travelled abroad?
questions.model: Yes, I have. I've been to France, Italy and the United Kingdom. My first trip abroad was to London with my school when I was fifteen. It was my first time on a plane, so I was very excited.

questions.q: Where would you like to go next?
questions.model: I'd like to go to Japan next. I'm very interested in its culture and its food. I've seen a lot of documentaries about Tokyo and Kyoto. I'm saving money, and I hope to go there next year.

questions.q: Do you prefer the beach or the mountains?
questions.model: I prefer the mountains. The beach is nice, but in summer it's too hot and there are too many people. In the mountains I can go hiking, and the air is fresh and clean. For example, last August we stayed in a small village in the Pyrenees and it was perfect.

questions.q: Are you working or studying?
questions.model: I'm doing both at the moment. I study engineering at university in the morning, and I work in a shop in the afternoon. It's quite hard because I don't have much free time. But I need the money, and the experience is useful.

questions.q: What do you like about your job or studies?
questions.model: What I like most about my job is my colleagues. We are a small team and we help each other a lot. For example, when I started, they taught me everything with a lot of patience. A good team makes a difficult job much easier.

questions.q: What would you like to do in the future?
questions.model: In the future I'd like to work as a teacher. I love working with children and I think teaching is a very important job. Last summer I helped at a summer camp and I really enjoyed it. That's why I'm going to study education next year.

questions.q: What's your dream job?
questions.model: My dream job is to be a travel journalist. I'd love to visit different countries and write about them. I already write a small blog about my trips. It's not easy to get a job like that, but I'll keep trying.

questions.q: Would you prefer to work in an office or from home?
questions.model: I'd prefer to work from home two or three days a week. At home I don't lose time travelling and I can concentrate better. However, I also like seeing my colleagues, so I wouldn't like to work from home every day. I think a mix is the best option.

questions.q: What's the weather like today?
questions.model: Today it's cloudy and a bit cold. This morning it rained for a few hours, so I took my umbrella. The forecast says it will be sunny tomorrow. I hope so, because I want to go for a walk.

questions.q: What's your favourite season?
questions.model: My favourite season is spring. It's not too hot and not too cold, and everything is green. For example, in April I love walking in the park when the flowers come out. Also, the days are longer, so I can do more things after work.

questions.q: What do you like doing when it rains?
questions.model: When it rains, I like staying at home with a hot chocolate and a good book. Sometimes I watch films with my family. I think rainy days are perfect for relaxing. But if it rains for a whole week, I start to feel sad.

questions.q: Does the weather change your mood?
questions.model: Yes, I think it does. When it's sunny, I feel happy and I want to go out. When it's grey and cold, I feel a bit lazy. That's why I prefer living in a place with a lot of sun.

questions.q: What's your favourite celebration?
questions.model: My favourite celebration is Christmas. The whole family gets together and we have a big dinner on Christmas Eve. We also give presents to each other. I love the lights in the streets and the special atmosphere.

questions.q: How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
questions.model: I usually celebrate my birthday with a dinner at home with my family and closest friends. I don't like big parties very much. For example, last year we had a barbecue in my parents' garden. It was simple, but I had a great time.

questions.q: Can you tell me about a party that you went to?
questions.model: Last summer I went to my cousin's wedding. It was in a beautiful old house in the country, with more than a hundred guests. There was delicious food, and we danced until three in the morning. It was one of the best parties of my life.

questions.q: Is there a special festival in your town?
questions.model: Yes, in my town there's a festival every September. There are concerts in the square, fireworks and a big parade. People come from other towns to see it. I think it's the best week of the year.

questions.q: What did you do last weekend?
questions.model: Last weekend I visited my grandparents in their village. On Saturday we went for a long walk and had lunch together. On Sunday I helped my grandfather in his garden. It was very relaxing, and I came back with lots of fresh vegetables.

questions.q: What are you going to do next weekend?
questions.model: Next weekend I'm going to go to the beach with some friends. We're going to take the train on Saturday morning and come back on Sunday. If the weather is good, we'll swim and have dinner by the sea. I'm really looking forward to it.

questions.q: What are your plans for the future?
questions.model: My plan is to finish my studies and find a good job. After that, I'd like to live in another country for a few years. For example, I'd love to work in Ireland or in Canada. But first I need to improve my English!

questions.q: What did you use to do when you were a child?
questions.model: When I was a child, I used to play football in the street with my friends every afternoon. We also used to spend the summers at my grandparents' house by the sea. I didn't have a mobile phone, so I was outside all the time. I think it was a very happy time.

questions.q: Would you prefer to live in a big city or a small town?
questions.model: I'd prefer to live in a big city. There are more jobs, more shops and more things to do, like concerts and museums. On the other hand, cities are noisy and expensive. But at my age, I think the city is the better option.

questions.q: Is it better to study alone or with friends?
questions.model: In my opinion, it depends on the subject. For difficult subjects, like maths, I prefer studying alone because I need to concentrate. However, for languages it's better to practise with friends. For example, I practise my English speaking with a classmate every week.

questions.q: Should children have mobile phones?
questions.model: I think young children shouldn't have mobile phones. They need to play outside and talk to people face to face. However, teenagers may need one to stay in contact with their parents. So I'd say thirteen is a good age to have a first phone.

questions.q: Is it important to learn English?
questions.model: Yes, I think it's very important. English is useful for travelling, for work and for understanding the internet. For example, a lot of jobs in my city ask for English. That's why I'm working hard to pass my B1 exam.
